category: Application Library examples: Uncertainty Quantification Module
description: Ready-made, documented example simulations installed with the Uncertainty Quantification Module. Each lists its physics interfaces, couplings and study steps; solve one with comsol_run_example or adapt its Java build script.

tools.name: Direct Monte Carlo Simulation of the Ishigami Function [Uncertainty Quantification Module example]
tools.description: Application Library example of the Uncertainty Quantification Module (Tutorials): Direct Monte Carlo Simulation of the Ishigami Function. Study steps: Parametric Sweep, Stationary. A ready model to start from for a similar simulation.
tools.usage: MCP: comsol_run_example("Uncertainty_Quantification_Module/Tutorials/ishigami_function_direct_monte_carlo") to solve it, comsol_example_info("ishigami_function_direct_monte_carlo", include_java=true) for its build script. COMSOL: File > Application Libraries > Uncertainty Quantification Module > Tutorials > ishigami function direct monte carlo
tools.notes: Library path Uncertainty_Quantification_Module/Tutorials/ishigami_function_direct_monte_carlo; model file 2.6 MB. Documented Java build script available (rebuild with comsol_run_example method='java'). Requires the module licence to open and solve.
